items.rationale: Escape of water from the cold line is covered. The panel is 2.4×0.85 + 2.4×0.4 ≈ 3.0 m², so the invoiced 3 m² matches; installed tiling rate × 3.
One hole through a new tile for the pipe was necessary. Prior rate of about 70 per piece × 1.
Same size and grade of basic tile as the original, so same kind and quality. Standard tile material rate × 3 m².
The soft patch of about 1 m² around the bend was built back up before tiling. Customary material rate × 1.
Duplicates the tile material already billed and is a non-standard oversized format. Excluded under 3.5(a) and 3.5(d).
Wall-to-plinth corner (2.4 m) plus panel end against the side wall (≈1.25 m) gives ≈3.6 m, consistent with the damage. About 10 €/m × 3.6.
Duplicates the silicone joints line and is a premium grade for a quantity not consistent with the damage. Excluded under 3.5(a), (d) and (e).
Under 7.4.2 one travel charge per contractor per document is reimbursed. Full rate about 82.
Under 7.4.1, labour already contained in the unit-rate lines is not payable again, and some hours may relate to the attic job. If paid, 14 h at the full trade rate.
Under 3.5(c), cleaning of the reinstated surface within the damage area remains part of the repair cost. Small flat rate.
The meter boxing was wet along the bottom and lies in the damage area. Removal is covered as opening up and debris removal; flat rate.

items.description: Removal and disposal of damaged insulation
items.rationale: The wet mineral wool from the boxing was disposed of by the tiler. This is a different removal from the container charge, so no duplicate; prior rate about 74.
The damp render behind the panel was hacked off over the same 3 m² area. Customary rate per m² × 3.
The attic gable staining is unrelated to the cellar leak and predates it (roof work). Outside the damage area, so excluded under 3.5(b).
The cover ring cracked when the tiles came off, so it is consequential damage. A standard chrome rosette is same kind and quality.
Re-sealing a leaking olive is not fracture damage under 2.4.3. It may be paid only if counted as making good or as dismantling for drying.
Drying was necessary per the documented readings (5.2.7). 7 days at a customary daily rental rate.
Under 5.2.7 ancillaries count as included in the dryer charge. Under 7.4.4 a flat surcharge is paid only if attributable, e.g. to the olive and sealing paste.
About 1 m of lagging was sodden by the escaping water. Prior rate about 22 €/m × 1.
Container for the broken tiles, render and board. Debris removal is reimbursed once under 5.2.1; prior rate about 60.
